{{Top|leg}}
'''Prishella''' was a [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] and commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Prishella once sliced into some [[New Republic Intelligence Service]] files that indicated a low-tech culture in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] was manufacturing [[BR1-Z]] [[blast-rifle]]s. Prishella shared the discovery while commenting on the weapon's entry in the Datalog.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
